news.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
news.body: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 以模块适配器更新能力
news.body: 补丁版保持基础模型不变，组合新的语音与决策适配器，并声明兼容 4.1。第三方 Adapter SDK 和教程仍在准备，不能写成现已全面可用。
news.title_original: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software

news.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
news.body: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

news.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
news.body: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

news.title: ProtoStar 推动公共资助科研成果便于 AI 复用
news.body: 倡议联合高校、研究机构和开放社区，将数据、模型及代码整理为可复用格式，并计划 11 月 2 日启动首个挑战。倡议发布不代表所有公共科研资源已完成开放。
news.title_original: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready

news.title: Hugging Face 介绍 Mistral Large 4 多模态模型
news.body: 文章介绍稀疏专家、稀疏注意力和图像输入等架构及评测。开放权重许可证包含服务用途限制，基准表现不能外推为所有任务或部署条件。
news.title_original: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face

news.title: Swift 开放模型接口扩展到语音识别与决策
news.body: AnySpeechRecognizer 和 AnyDecisionModel 提供熟悉的接口，可下载开放模型并在设备运行。可用模型、系统版本及硬件条件仍需逐项确认。
news.title_original: Introducing AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel: Open Models for Speech and Decisions on Apple Platforms

news.title: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 整合多语言语音任务
news.body: 开放权重模型结合转写、说话人归属、翻译和音频问答，并配套 Granary 数据流程及适配方法。语言覆盖因任务而异，榜单表现不能代表所有口音、场景或部署条件。
news.title_original: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt

news.title: OpenAI 与 ServiceNow 扩展企业工作流合作
news.body: 合作计划把模型及智能体连接到开发、IT 和安全流程，操作受组织权限与业务规则约束。公告中的新集成不应全部视为已向所有客户开放。
news.title_original: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
news.body_original: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.

news.title: MIT 访谈探讨基础设施的设计、融资与运营挑战
news.body: 访谈讨论气候、能源、AI 和供应链压力下如何建设基础设施，强调多方协作与全流程考量。属于专家观点，不是具体工程效果的验证报告。
news.title_original: 3 Questions: Why infrastructure is entering a defining era
news.body_original: Professor Ali Jadbabaie describes how AI, digital transformation, climate change, and complex geopolitics are forcing engineers and policymakers to rethink how infrastructure is designed, built, and managed.

news.title: 评论文章探讨 AI 如何改变企业组织结构
news.body: 两位作者讨论 AI 进入管理层级与协作关系的可能路径，并提出自主性、规模和薪酬问题。文章明确代表作者个人观点，不能视为已证实的经济预测。
news.body_original: How AI might enter the org chart—beneath, beside, and between us.

news.title: Legora 分享法律智能体与文档审查实践
news.body: 客户案例介绍将模型用于法律工作流和大规模文档审查。节时与周转改善来自企业自报，实际法律结论仍需专业审核。
news.title_original: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
news.body_original: See how Legora uses OpenAI models, ChatGPT, and Codex to accelerate legal workflows, expand contract analysis, and free lawyers to focus on higher-value work.

news.title: MIT 研究者探索让机器更好地理解声音
news.body: 人物报道介绍声源分离、音频增强和声音分析等研究方向。交通事故定位等例子体现潜在用途，不等于所有相关产品已完成部署验证。
news.body_original: Professor Paris Smaragdis develops computers with superhuman hearing for applications like speech recognition, music understanding, and environmental monitoring.

news.title: 睡眠框架探索大模型持续学习与记忆巩固
news.body: 研究交替使用主动交互与离线巩固，把短期上下文转为参数中的知识，并评估遗忘与推理。特定实验结果不保证任意模型都能无限记忆或持续更新。
news.title_original: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning

news.title: LFM3 以共享骨干支持专门化多模态模型
news.body: 系列在约二十亿参数级别提供文本、视觉、语音等分支，强调本地部署和任务微调。不同设备、后端与上下文长度的性能仍需按实际负载验证。
news.title_original: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
